The '''Trial of the First Commando''' was a challenge used as part of the [[Voss commandos]] training. Beneath the [[Shrine of Healing]] the commandos would spar one another, sometimes even inviting the outsiders. Mystic healers would watch over the Trials, so even though injuries were sustained, the Trials would usually end without deaths.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=heroic|The First Commando's Call|Voss}}</ref>
